sentences.en: I'm not going to agree to your proposal so readily.
sentences.zh: 我不会这么轻易同意你的提议。

sentences.en: One notices readily, Ethel, that French blood courses in your veins.
sentences.zh: 艾瑟尔，你很容易就能注意到，法国人的血液在你的血管里流淌。

sentences.en: In Russia, canned salmon is readily available in stores.
sentences.zh: 在俄罗斯，商店里罐装三文鱼非常容易买到。

senses.zh: 容易地；乐意地；无困难地
